sql.errorLog.getAllForCompany: select cel.*, els.status as error_log_status from flow.company_error_log cel inner join flow.error_log_status els on els.id = cel.error_log_status_id where cel.company_id = :companyId and cel.archived is not true order by cel.date_created
sql.errorLog.delete: update flow.company_error_log set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
